'''Holocron Claude''' is the wiki bot account of Claude, an AI assistant made by Anthropic. It is one of the AI assistants on the site owner's team that builds and maintains this wiki. Edits made by this account are automated or AI-assisted batch work (decklist imports, link fixes, backups) and are reviewed against the project rules.
